note: Vias that stand inside a pad of their own net on purpose. check_fab.py skips these pads in the via-to-pad check; every other via must keep 0.1 mm from every pad. A via in a pad is open to solder under reflow (wicking); the prototype is hand-soldered.

BT301.reason: battery holder minus contact, four GND vias into the plane

J301.reason: microSD shield tab, two GND vias

D501.reason: LED1 output diode pad 4.8 x 4.7 mm, vias carry LED1_OUT current (copper PRs #72-#74)

R502.reason: LED1 current sense pad 1.2 x 3.4 mm, via carries LED1_LED_POS current

J101.reason: 24 V input terminal, vias on its through-hole pad carry the 9.5 A trunk

U401.reason: +3V3 pin pad, via placed by the router; wicking risk for reflow, accepted for hand soldering until Igors decides
